javascript: Optional. With the GGDS script, below 80rem the sections go behind a menu button that opens the list in place and closes with Escape, returning focus to the button. Without it, the sections show as a list under the name.
classes: The header. Sticky, white, with the flag colours as a thin line above and a line in the institution's colour below.
The row inside the page width.
The link home: logo or initials, name and country.
The institution's initials in a round badge, until it has an approved logo.
The institution's name, in its colour.
A name longer than 45 characters: set smaller on phones.
"Republic of Ghana" under the name, on wide screens.
Added by the GGDS script: the navigation can be hidden behind the menu button.
The link to the search page, with its icon.
The word "Search": shown on wide screens, otherwise kept for screen readers only.
The menu button. Has hidden until the GGDS script shows it.
The menu icon, shown while the menu is closed.
The close icon, shown while the menu is open.
states: The section the visitor is in: marked with a line in the link colour, and underlined on wide screens.
The menu is open: the close icon shows.
The menu is closed (set by the GGDS script).
astro:
<Header name="National Communications Authority" initials="NCA"
  nav={[{ label: 'Services', href: '/services/' }, { label: 'About', href: '/about/' }]}
  current={Astro.url.pathname} />
django: {% ggds_header name="National Communications Authority" initials="NCA" nav=nav %}
tests: opens in place, closes with Escape and returns focus
navigation is visible and the menu button is not
one row from 80rem: name, navigation and Search side by side
the header row fits inside the page at 1280px and 1440px, even with six sections
